title: Repair an overflowing ADC average
description: Repair uint16_t adc_average(const uint16_t *samples, size_t n).
prompt:
Repair uint16_t adc_average(const uint16_t *samples, size_t n).
A board reports unexpectedly small averages at high input voltage. The current accumulator is only 16 bits. Return the integer mean rounded down, or zero when n is zero. All samples are unsigned 16-bit values and n is at most 65535.
constraints: samples may be NULL when n is zero.
No floating point or heap allocation.
Explain why your accumulator is sufficiently wide.

tests.name: Normal readings
Empty batch
Full scale
Maximum batch

rubric: Respect the stated contract and bounds.
Explain integer widths, ownership, and relevant edge cases.
Separate host-test evidence from hardware guarantees.
follow_ups: Which boundary conditions would you test on the target?
What changes if the function is called from an ISR?
hints: Write down the boundary cases before choosing an implementation.
Use explicit integer widths and keep intermediate values in range.
